# 🚦 Post-Deployment Verification

## Deployment metadata

- Environment:
- Deployed commit:
- Workflow run:
- Artifact:
- Deployment URL:
- Deployed at (UTC):
- Verifier:
- Browser / version:

## Availability and assets

- [ ] Main page loads over HTTPS.
- [ ] Correct release is visible.
- [ ] Branded favicon loads.
- [ ] Stylesheets and scripts load.
- [ ] Fonts load or readable fallback appears.
- [ ] No broken asset path or unexpected redirect appears.

## Chat smoke tests

- [ ] Initial greeting is visible.
- [ ] Plain text prompt can be submitted.
- [ ] Enter submits exactly once.
- [ ] Send button submits exactly once.
- [ ] Empty input is ignored.
- [ ] Known trigger returns the expected scripted response category.
- [ ] Unknown trigger returns a fallback.
- [ ] Clear conversation works.
- [ ] Minimize and expand work.
- [ ] Latest message scrolls into view.

## Responsive and accessibility checks

- [ ] Narrow viewport remains usable.
- [ ] Long text wraps.
- [ ] Keyboard focus is visible.
- [ ] Reduced-motion preference is respected.
- [ ] Browser console has no new errors.

## Evidence and outcome

Record screenshots, logs, browser versions, test results, and any limitations without private chat content. Outcome: pass / fail / partial. List defects, owner, and rollback decision.
